title: Alginate Dressings Versus Gauge Dressings After Pilonidal Cyst Resection: Examination of the Quality of Life
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the application of alginate dressings with silver and high-G cellulose and the use of simple gauge dressings in patients submitted to surgical resection of pilonidal cyst. The present trial will focus on the postoperative quality of life during the secondary intention wound healing.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female
* Pilonidal cyst
* Age: 18 to 80 years
* American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) score: I, II, III, IV
* Disease stage I,II,III and IV

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pilonidal abscess
* Patient age ≥ 80 years or \< 18 years
* Pilonidal abscess
